text:
Maya Patel: Quick note — during Gemma->Llama3 bring-up I observed a small but consistent drop on summarization BLEU when we enabled the rotary harmonic per-head scaling + new vocab vectormap. Not huge but reproducible across seeds.
Samir: Are both changes from the same conversion PR?
Maya Patel: Yes, we applied headwise phase-scale to keep frequencies aligned and switched to a vectormap-based vocab offset to collapse duplicate codepoints.
Jin Park: Can you paste the eval snippet?
Maya Patel: ```
# eval summary
model: gemma->llama3-conv-v2
quant: int8-static
promptset: summarization-small
seeds: 42,43,44
BLEU: baseline 28.4 -> conv-v2 26.9
ROUGE-L: baseline 34.1 -> conv-v2 33.2
latency: +3% p99
```
Samir: fp16 matches baseline?
Maya Patel: fp16 within noise. Regression shows after quant and with long prefixes (>512).
Kai: Could vectormap shift token ids leading to KV cache misalignment? Any token-id histogram diffs?
Maya Patel: Ran a 10k sample diff: ~0.7% tokens remapped vs old converter, mostly punctuation and infrequent diacritics.
Jin Park: That explains boundary effects on summarization metrics.
Samir: Let's run A/B: (A) old vocab remap + new harmonic scaling, (B) new vectormap + disable harmonic scale.
Maya Patel: A locally single-seed -> BLEU 28.1 (mostly recovered). B queued on CI.
EvalBot: CI job queued 7743220001 (A/B sweep seeds 1-3; int8,int4,fp16). ETA ~45m.
Kai: Also try disabling KV prefix caching on int8 runs in case cache indices assume previous token ordering.
Maya Patel: Adding that to matrix.
Jin Park: We should add a tokenizer-preservation check to the converter pipeline: assert <0.1% remap on top 100k tokens and alert on punctuation spikes.
Samir: Also add a quick eval in onboarding: histogram diff, per-token embedding cosine for top tokens, and a short quality smoke.
Maya Patel: Opening a rollback PR to revert vectormap by default until we validate. Will attach bisect notes.
EvalBot: CI results for 7743220001: int8(A) passed seeds 1-3; int8(B) still regressed; int4 showed higher variance. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/7743220001/
Maya Patel: Conclusion: harmonic scaling is OK; vectormap remap causes subtle token-id shadowing under quantization. Reverting vectormap default.
Jin Park: Add checklist item: run quant-sensitivity across tokenizer diffs on new model bring-ups.
Kai: Filing RFC for opt-in vectormap + preservation checks for Dedicated customers.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — closing loop.
